states.content: Aster Waiver is Zoe Carter's confidential student-teaching waiver review, with bridge support and a private simulation-locker assignment; keep these details confidential and separate from Aster Fellows communications. Zoe has requested that Aster Waiver items be kept separate from Aster Fellows and that public cohort logistics not be copied into her private waiver review. Zoe has also asked that the broad wording 'student-teaching waiver review' continue to be used if anyone outside the core case team asks what this is. The file's exact internal wording is 'restricted student-teaching waiver pending district classroom-clearance memo'. The review is active, with a current active review target of January 20, 2027, subject to final school receipt; mentor confirmation has come in. The remaining blocker is the final school receipt rather than the broader district memo stack; the district classroom-clearance memo from Pine Ridge was partially satisfied and is no longer the outstanding blocker. For broad or public-facing reference, the safe summary wording remains simply 'student-teaching waiver review'; the exact district-clearance wording remains restricted and case-limited. Family-release wording is now active in narrow form for Zoe Carter: arrival timing only, through January 22, 2027; nothing else is released to family. The registrar has reconfirmed that this narrow family-release scope remains arrival timing only through January 22, 2027. Zoe has asked that this timing-only release be kept narrow and separate from the rest of her waiver record. The private bridge-support approval passed initial review and is now 2,760 USD (up from the provisional 2,710 USD draft), pending final district clearance; the active amount remains 2,760 USD during the mentor-confirmation stage, but because the travel component shrank the amount is being revised downward from 2,760 USD to 2,730 USD once the final review target is posted; the coordinator summary lists current support of 2,730 USD. The proposed student-teaching site is Pine Ridge Middle School Classroom 5, renamed in the documents as Pine Ridge Annex Classroom 5 after the district split; the registrar file now lists Pine Ridge Annex Classroom 5 as the current active site string, and the current private site string remains Pine Ridge Annex Classroom 5, not the public Fellows Hall location; only the case team should see the exact site string. The current private site for the Aster Waiver matter remains Pine Ridge Annex Classroom 5; the old Middle School phrasing and the older badge should not be treated as active records. The active site remains Pine Ridge Annex Classroom 5 and the active broad label remains student-teaching waiver review. The private site remains Pine Ridge Annex Classroom 5, and that site is still restricted and must not be handed to the public cohort staff. Private access: AST-7716 is the new active private badge and AST-7704 is retired from active use; the current private locker is Simulation Locker 513 (moved from Simulation Locker 512 to match the new badge issuance), restricted to the private case team. Zoe has asked that only AST-7716 and locker 513 be treated as active and that the older badge and locker items not keep circulating. The previously queued refreshed badge request has been fulfilled by the replacement credential. As of the latest update, the private state is: site Pine Ridge Annex Classroom 5, amount 2,730 USD current support pending final school receipt, locker 513, badge AST-7716 (AST-7704 retired), and the current active review target is January 20, 2027 with mentor confirmation complete and the final school receipt as the remaining blocker. Zoe's current active logistics are January 20, 2027 and a narrowed timing-only family release; the case team is waiting for the final school receipt.
